core_principles: Clarity over complexity: Field staff need large, readable inputs under sunlight.
Trust and Precision: The cost estimation must feel reliable and professional.
Progressive Disclosure: Break down complex site visit data into a manageable multi-step form.
Eco-Tech Aesthetic: Blend earthy sustainability with high-tech precision.

primary.description: Sensoper Forest Green - used for primary actions, active states, and key highlights.

secondary.description: Sensoper Ocean Blue - used for secondary actions, informational badges, and progress indicators.

background.description: Slightly cool off-white to reduce glare for field staff outdoors.

surface.description: Pure white for cards and forms to ensure high contrast.

accent.description: Warm amber for pending statuses, warnings, or draft projects.

rules: Use Outfit for a modern, geometric tech feel mixed with friendliness.
Use Figtree for highly legible form inputs and data tables.

spacing_and_layout.form_layout: max-w-3xl mx-auto p-6 md:p-8 bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm
spacing_and_layout.spacing_scale: Use generous padding (p-6, p-8) inside containers.
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: rounded-xl for main containers, rounded-lg for inputs/buttons.

surfaces.cards: Flat solid background, 1px border (border-slate-200), no heavy drop shadows. On hover: shadow-md and -translate-y-[2px] transition.
surfaces.header: Solid white background with border-b border-slate-200. Sticky top with z-50.

components.buttons: Shadcn standard. Primary uses Forest Green. Secondary uses Ocean Blue. Always include distinct hover states.
components.forms: Multi-step form with a horizontal progress stepper at the top. Use Shadcn Form, Input, Select, Checkbox. Group related fields (Customer Info, GPS, Electrical, Solar Inputs).
components.tables: Shadcn Table for project tracking. Clean, border-b only for rows. Use badges for status (Draft, Submitted, Approved).
components.charts: Shadcn Charts (Recharts) for cost breakdown (Pie Chart for Materials vs Labor).
components.cards: Go cardless where possible in dashboards, or use subtle 1px border cards.
components.modals: Shadcn Dialog for quick actions (e.g., viewing an uploaded site image).

interactions_and_animations.hover: Subtle transform and shadow updates on interactive cards. Color shifts on buttons.
interactions_and_animations.form_transitions: Smooth fade/slide when moving between multi-step form sections (use Framer Motion).
interactions_and_animations.loading: Skeleton loaders for data fetching. Spinner for form submissions.
interactions_and_animations.micro_interactions: Checkmark animations on successful step completion.

icons.usage: Use icons for form step indicators, dashboard sidebar navigation, and status badges. Keep stroke-width to 2px.

login_background.description: Rows of solar panels on a roof. Use with a heavy gradient overlay (bg-black/60) or white overlay depending on login card style.

hero_alternative.description: Close-up of solar panels on a red tiled roof. Good for marketing or PDF cover pages.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard HTML/Tailwind CSS with Shadcn UI for the entire application.
Implement role-based routing (Admin, Manager, Staff). Staff mostly use the Multi-step Site Visit Form.
The Multi-step form MUST use progressive disclosure: Step 1 (Customer/Location), Step 2 (Site Details & Photos), Step 3 (Electrical & Solar Inputs).
Use Recharts (via Shadcn) to display cost estimation breakdowns.
For the PDF generation, use a library like 'jspdf' and 'html2canvas' or '@react-pdf/renderer'. Ensure the Sensoper logo (placeholder if missing) and primary green color are prominent in the PDF.
Ensure the dashboard utilizes the 'Control Room Grid' approach for admins/managers to track projects.
Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Use 'Outfit' for headings and 'Figtree' for body text. Load them via Google Fonts.
Add data-testid attributes to all form inputs, buttons, and critical UI elements for automated testing.
